Is parking free at your hotel?.reply: Yes, self‑parking in our on‑site lot is free, with one vehicle per room included. No reservation or valet is required, and oversized vehicles park in the rear lot under the same free terms.

How much is the pet fee per night?.reply: The pet fee is $25 per night.

What time is breakfast served?.reply: Breakfast is served daily from 6:30 AM to 9:30 AM Eastern in the lobby.

Until when can I cancel for free?.reply: You can cancel free of charge by 3:00 PM Eastern the day before your arrival day.

What time is check-in?.reply: Standard check‑in is from 3:00 PM Eastern. The front desk is staffed 24 hours, so you can arrive at any time after 3:00 PM Eastern.
